parent_objective: audit the first fair public profile-comparison pilot before increasing budget or making stronger claims
blocked_by: M1199 produced public pilot trends but also L2 window-equivalence and L3 reset-parity patterns that need audit
supersedes: directly scaling the strongest M1199 public pilot profile without checking profile separation
invalidates: claiming recurrent-hidden benefit or paper-level profile ranking directly from M1199

public_gates: M1200 may audit M1199 artifacts only
M1200 must not run candidate replay
M1200 must not use private holdout
M1200 must not tune profiles based on M1199 results
M1200 must not claim paper-level evidence or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not scale L2 before auditing window-equivalence
do not discard L3 before auditing reset-control parity
do not tune one profile and compare against frozen profiles
do not promote any M1199 checkpoint
do not claim recurrent-belief advantage or self-identification

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_public_pilot_audit: profile separation and next-route decision
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M1199 public trends justify longer comparison or require finite-window/L3 implementation and capacity repair first
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no training promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if L2 window-equivalence cannot be explained from existing artifacts
stop if L3 reset parity suggests the recurrent hidden state was not materially used in this pilot
stop if M1199 metric aggregation is found inconsistent
stop if the audit would require profile-specific tuning before a fair protocol is redefined
fallback_plan: route to finite-window profile implementation audit if L2 windows are effectively equivalent
route to L3 recurrent-state/capacity audit if reset parity remains unexplained
route to repeated pilot if artifacts are consistent and profile separation is adequate
route to metric repair if aggregation or evaluation masking is flawed
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1199 completed the first public fair profile pilot and produced nontrivial but potentially confounded trends

admission_evidence: M1199 completed all selected profile seed runs
M1199 public eval metrics are finite
M1199 did not promote, use private holdout, tune profiles, or change actor inputs
M1199 produced L2 finite-window trend plus L2 window-equivalence and L3 reset-parity audit questions
blocked_shortcuts: do not train controllers in M1200
do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: M1199 aggregate and seed-level trends are summarized
L2 window-equivalence is classified as expected, suspicious, or inconclusive
L3 reset-control parity is classified as expected, suspicious, or inconclusive
the next route is chosen without profile-specific tuning

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1200 audits a public pilot that does not isolate history necessity; current-frame and short-window feedback may substitute for recurrent hidden state.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1200 may audit profile windows but does not run same-current or wrong-history interventions.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If L3 reset parity persists, record it as lack of recurrent-hidden evidence in this pilot and do not weaken the self-ID standard.
allowed_claims: route decision for next fair comparison or implementation audit
no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: The M1199 public pilot can be audited into a safe next-route decision without expanding its claim scope.
success_criteria: M1199 aggregate and seed-level trends are summarized
L2 window-equivalence and L3 reset-control parity are explicitly audited
no controller training, candidate replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, per-profile tuning, or actor-input contract change occurs
failure_criteria: M1199 is framed as paper-level evidence
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
audit skips the L2 window-equivalence or L3 reset-parity issues
decision_rule: M1200 passes if it converts M1199 into a safe next-route decision without training, tuning, promotion, private holdout, or claim expansion.
